## Description

Measures continuous Transfer Entropy and Directed Information flows between macroeconomic indicators and asset classes to construct dynamically directed causal portfolio allocation weights.

## Where it may fit

Global macro regime transitions, central bank policy shifts, inflationary regime changes.

## Vehicles

Global Macro Funds, Tactical Asset Allocation Portfolios.

## Required data

Macroeconomic time series (CPI, PMI, employment, yield spreads), cross-asset index return series.

## Caveats

Probability density estimation via kernel density estimators is sensitive to bandwidth selection.
